from collections import Counter
def bboxes():
    out=[]
    for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('B','c','Y') and n['pixels']>20:
            b=n['boundary']; rows=[p[0] for p in b]; cols=[p[1] for p in b]
            out.append((n['color'], min(rows), min(cols), max(rows), max(cols), n['pixels']))
    return out
print("before:", bboxes())
res = action(['RIGHT','RIGHT'])
print("after RIGHTx2:", bboxes(), {k: last_action_result.get(k) for k in ('done','level_completed','game_over')})
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
